text: Raven's stance on the AI backlash: public AI-shaming/harassment of creators (e.g. the Jorge Gutierrez episode he cited — unverified specifics) is a travesty. Stigma is a selective filter that disarms honest individuals while opaque institutions use AI freely; it also pushes use underground = LESS transparency. Legitimate AI grievances (jobs, training data) are valid; mob cruelty/patronizing is not. 'Creative living for all means all' — no loyalty test on tools. This is The Grid's reason for being.
